title: Luke Skywalker
description: When Grogu reached out with the Force to find Jedi, his message was felt by Luke Skywalker. Grogu was then captured by Moff Gideon's Dark Troopers. During the rescue attempt led by the Mandalorian, Grogu and his friends were cornered by the Dark Troopers. Skywalker arrived and destroyed the Dark Troopers. He then took Grogu for training in the Force.
